description: Declared mutants of v8-arch-big-map-engine-format (judgment F2 of docs/architecture/plans/big-map/engine-format.zh-Hant.md): gyo.voxel_map and gyo.voxel_region in GYO::VoxelMesh and gyo.map_markers in GYO::MapMarkers. mm-two-shapes-accepted survived in the engine-map run (two shapes are also rejected as an unknown field); see the engine-format dev_log. Run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/big-map/scripts/engine_format_mutations.json --build-dir build/target/_build/test. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message. Test-case filters must not contain commas: doctest splits -tc on commas, and a filter that matches nothing passes.
